Admission to a graduate program or professional school is selective and it’s important to pay attention to details. Your application is the primary way you will be presenting yourself as a candidate for admission, so it pays to research program requirements carefully and submit a strong application.
We are a vibrant, diverse, and inclusive academic community. We hope you’ll find your place with us.
Step By Step: Applying for Graduate or Professional Study
You are eligible to apply for graduate admission if you have completed your bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) or will complete it before the start of your graduate studies. Professional degrees may have different requirements - please be sure to always view the program page for specific requirements.
1
Submit Application
Review your program's application requirements. You can search for your program in our Graduate and Professional Program Finder. Note any prerequisite courses, licensures, GPA, or other requirements that may be included in your program’s application process. The application can be completed in 5-10 minutes. You are not required to submit or upload any application materials during this step. If you find yourself stuck at any part of the application process, please fill out a Help Ticket in your Applicant Status Portal.
2
Submit Materials
Once you submit your application, your Applicant Status Portal will generate a detailed list of any supplemental requirements, including instructions on how to fulfill each item. You may also review FAQs, track your application progress, and view upcoming program events within your portal.
3
Application & Material Review
Once all materials have been received and your application is marked as “complete,” your admission packet will be reviewed by the admission committee.
4
Decision
Admission decisions are typically made within 4 to 6 weeks from when your application is complete. However, some programs wait to review applications until the deadline has passed. Please refer to your program page for specific details. Once a decision is made, we will notify you by email. You may also log in to your Applicant Status Portal to check the status of your application.
Explore Financial Aid Options
Research and make decisions about your funding options. Apply for any financial aid, scholarships, and assistantships or fellowships that are applicable.
LEARN MORE
Admission Requirements
Each professional school and program has its own policies, admissions, and degree requirements. Please check each program page for more detailed information. In general, be prepared to provide:
A Completed Application
You can fill out and submit your application online; there is no fee to apply to graduate programs. You don’t have to finish your application all at once — you can start and save your information and log in later to finish using your email address and password. Once you begin your application, you will have access to a checklist of all required material, allowing you to easily see what may be missing. When all sections are complete, click “submit.” You may return and upload documents after submission.
Official Transcripts
Test Scores
Letters of Recommendation
Statement of Purpose
Identity Verification
Sending Your Application Materials
Official transcripts and test scores must be sent directly by the college/university or testing agency to Loyola University Chicago at gradapp@luc.edu. For fastest processing, all other materials should be directly uploaded to your Applicant Status Portal.
Printed documents and materials may be sent to:
Graduate and Professional Enrollment Management
Loyola University Chicago
820 N. Michigan Avenue, Lewis Towers, 12th Floor
Chicago, IL 60611
*Please note, documents mailed to the above address may take 2-3 weeks longer for processing.
International Students
International applicants from all nations are welcome at Loyola, but please note that there may be additional requirements for admission, which you can find outlined on our International Applicant Requirements page. Some requirements may vary based on your program, so please additionally refer to each program’s specific requirements when preparing your application.
In need of further assistance? The Loyola Office of International and Student Scholar Services provides support and services for international students including comprehensive immigration-related advising services and a diverse array of programming and events to engage international students and scholars with communities on-campus and throughout the City of Chicago.

When you receive your acceptance notification and inform us of your intent to enroll, you’ll be at the start of an educational journey that will be intellectually challenging and personally enriching.
We will work with you to make a smooth transition to graduate studies. As we welcome you to the Loyola community, log in to your admitted student page for more information on advising, orientation, technology setup, and more.
